svg.text: RCA PAYMENT GATEWAY · THE TWO OPEN QUESTIONS
Both answers are a config change, not a redesign.
Nik has been asked whether the online payment is the full fee or a deposit, and whether prices go public. The
layout was built so neither answer costs a rework — here is what each looks like.
Secured by Razorpay · UPI, cards, net banking
Everything the student pays is online, so 100% of the fee is
inside the rev-share base. Highest friction on a cold page —
but they arrive here after a counselling call, not cold.
